dogecoin.text: @elonmusk You know what else your assembly workers own, other than dogecoin? Dollars! How about you support dollars instead of international crypto. Supporting dollar = supporting usa government and usa citizens by extension!

@elonmusk I support dollar, again. Support currency that you own the most. Common Americans own more dollars. Dogecoin has built in inflation of 3%. You put down common ppl if you support crypto over local currency.
